Final restrained craft refinement. Preserve the entire layout, camera, black copy space, warm lighting, input-envelope tray, paper route, review tray, lamp, hand anatomy/position/cuff, Canon's exact oval woven eyes and expression, silhouette and pose. The human and Canon must continue holding the same reply for review; no sending or completed approval.
Refine two small details in place: (1) On Canon's charcoal felt, replace the conspicuous repeating wavy/looped fiber pattern with the fine, quiet, irregular soft felt fibers of Image 2. Preserve material depth and the woven digital face; no plastic, glass, shiny metal, smooth rubber, or change of identity. No letters, words or numerals. It should look embossed into real paper, clear at modest size but not a logo or a UI screenshot.
Change nothing else. Keep the hand natural and the person visibly examining the reply. Do not add more fingers, humans, objects, badges, approval checkmarks, glow or decorative effects. Landscape16:9, original scene and crop retained. Separate new image; preserve previous versions.
